title: 3811. Number of Alternating XOR Partitions

examples.explanation: The XOR of [2, 3] is 1, which matches target1. The XOR of the remaining block [1, 4] is 5, which matches target2. This is the only valid alternating partition, so the answer is 1.

The XOR of [1, 0, 0] is 1, which matches target1. The XOR of [1] and [0, 0] are 1 and 0, matching target1 and target2. The XOR of [1, 0] and [0] are 1 and 0, matching target1 and target2. Thus, the answer is 3.
The XOR of [7] is 7, which does not match target1, so no valid partition exists.
